validation.email: This is not a valid email address.
error.validation.error.title: The request is not valid
error.validation.error.detail: Some fields are not valid: see the message beside each one.
error.invoice.not.draft.title: The invoice is not a draft
error.invoice.not.draft.detail: Only a draft can be changed: an issued invoice is a document, and a void one is history.
error.invoice.is.paid.title: The invoice is settled
error.invoice.is.paid.detail: Money came in against this invoice: reverse the payment before voiding it.
error.invoice.not.issued.title: The invoice is not issued
error.invoice.not.issued.detail: Only an issued invoice can be paid or voided: nobody has been asked to pay a draft, and a draft is deleted rather than voided.
error.overpayment.title: More than is owed
error.overpayment.detail: {amountDue} {currency} is still owed on this invoice, and this payment is more than that.
error.currency.mismatch.title: Another currency
error.currency.mismatch.detail: This invoice is settled in {expected}, and the payment arrived in {offered}.
error.customer.not.found.title: Customer not found
error.customer.not.found.detail: This company's register holds no customer with that identifier.
error.invoice.number.contended.title: Number contended
error.invoice.number.contended.detail: Another invoice took the next number at the same moment: ask again.
error.unknown_vat_rate.title: VAT rate not in use
error.unknown_vat_rate.detail: The rates in use are 0, 4, 5, 10 and 22 per cent.
error.forbidden.title: Not allowed
error.forbidden.detail: You are missing the permission this needs: {permissions}.

reminder.body: our invoice {number} of {outstanding} was due on {due} and is still open. A copy is attached.
